Direcția Generală Coordonare Asistență E: General Directorate for External Assistance Coordination and European Funds
Cancelaria de Stat a Republicii Moldova: State Chancellery of the Republic of Moldova
Asigurăm rolul Cancelariei de Stat în ca: We ensure the State Chancellery's role as the national authority for coordinating external assistance: planning, programming, monitoring and evaluating assistance, including European Union pre-accession assistance, and coordinating the investment projects of the Growth Plan. Here you will find the projects, legal acts, reports, financing agreements and events for potential beneficiaries.
Direcția generală este subdiviziunea Can: The General Directorate is the unit of the State Chancellery that ensures its role as the national authority for coordinating external assistance. It is responsible for coordinating the planning, programming, implementation monitoring and evaluation of external assistance, including European Union pre-accession assistance and European funds, as well as institutional preparation for managing European funds. It reports directly to the Secretary General of the Government.
Misiunea Direcției este coordonarea și g: The Directorate's mission is the effective coordination and management of external assistance, so that it is aligned with national and sectoral policy priorities and the budget framework, and so that its impact on the country's sustainable development and on preparation for accession to the European Union is as great as possible.
Planificarea și programarea asistenței e: Planning and programming of external assistance
Coordonarea, în calitate de autoritate n: Coordinating, as the national authority for coordinating external assistance, the process of planning and programming external assistance by aligning it with national development priorities and harmonising it with the budgetary policy-planning cycle, as well as preparing for accession to the European Union.
Asigurarea programării și diversificării: Ensuring that external assistance is programmed and diversified in line with national and sectoral development priorities and the national budget planning framework.
Identificarea și definitivarea necesităț: Identifying and finalising external assistance needs and examining external assistance project/programme proposals in light of the Government's priorities and the commitments made to the international community and, in particular, to the European Union.
Asigurarea direcționării eficiente a asi: Ensuring that assistance is channelled effectively, in order to avoid overlap and fragmentation of external funding intended for certain sectors, in accordance with the priorities set out in national development strategies and programmes.
Coordonarea interacțiunii intersectorial: Coordinating cross-sectoral interaction between external assistance projects and programmes.
Asigurarea suportului informațional pent: Providing information support for the work of the Inter-ministerial Committee for Strategic Planning (ICSP) on external assistance projects/programmes.
Examinarea matricelor de angajamente/con: Examining the matrices of commitments/conditionalities undertaken under the policy matrices of budget support programmes, development policy operations, etc., negotiated with development partners, and their implementation reports, as well as proposals for external assistance programmes and projects for approval on the ICSP platform by the responsible authorities.
Coordonarea procesului de elaborare, neg: Coordinating the process of drafting, negotiating and signing the agreements under which external assistance is provided, in line with the priorities set by the Government and development needs.
Consolidarea capacităților coordonatoril: Strengthening the capacities of sectoral coordinators/beneficiaries in identifying external assistance needs and drafting external assistance project/programme proposals.
Punct unic de contact pentru partenerii: Single point of contact for development partners
Realizarea rolului de punct unic de cont: Acting as the single point of contact/control in relations with external development partners and public authorities on external assistance project/programme proposals, and working with the central public authorities responsible for sector policy/sectoral coordinators and/or other public authorities, beneficiaries and the development partner community to resolve any problems that arise in managing external assistance at national level.
Asigurarea rolului de punct unic de cont: Acting as the single point of contact in relations with external development partners and public authorities on external assistance project/programme proposals.
Cooperarea cu structurile și organizații: Cooperating with international structures and organisations and development partners on concluding financing/cooperation agreements and on all aspects of external assistance coordination, including EU pre-accession assistance for candidate countries/EU funds.
Facilitarea și impulsionarea proiectelor: Facilitating and speeding up external assistance projects/programmes through effective cooperation with the central public authorities responsible for sector policy/sectoral coordinators and/or other public authorities, beneficiaries and the development partner community.
Examinarea solicitărilor privind finanța: Examining requests for financing, extension, restructuring or suspension of external assistance projects/programmes, or other proposals needed to ensure sustainable and efficient use of available resources, and submitting them for approval on the ICSP platform by the responsible authorities.
Diseminarea informației potențialilor be: Disseminating information to potential beneficiaries on opportunities/deadlines for obtaining external assistance.
Asigurarea unui dialog transparent și pr: Ensuring a transparent and productive dialogue with the donor/creditor community on all aspects of financing new external assistance projects/programmes and on progress in implementing ongoing projects/programmes.
Monitorizarea activității consiliilor se: Monitoring the activity of sectoral councils in the field of external assistance and providing methodological and information support to ensure the effectiveness of these platforms.
Monitorizarea, raportarea și evaluarea p: Monitoring, reporting and evaluation of projects
Coordonarea la nivel național a procesul: Coordinating at national level the process of monitoring the implementation of external assistance projects/programmes, as well as the reporting and evaluation of programmes and projects financed from external sources.
Coordinating at national level the process of monitoring the implementation of projects/programmes financed from external sources.
Prezentarea propunerilor de sporire a ef: Presenting proposals to increase the efficiency of the use of funds provided by external donors and creditors.
Monitorizarea și analiza eficienței, efi: Monitoring and analysing the efficiency, effectiveness, impact and sustainability of projects/programmes financed from external sources, in order to remove bottlenecks and constraints and take effective optimisation/remedial measures.
Monitorizarea și raportarea privind impl: Monitoring and reporting on the implementation of EU pre-accession funds and external assistance in order to achieve the Government's strategic development priorities.
Coordonarea și organizarea procesului de: Coordinating and organising the process of evaluating the implementation of projects/programmes financed from external sources and of EU pre-accession assistance for candidate countries.
Asigurarea vizibilității, evidenței și v: Ensuring the visibility, recording and validation of external assistance projects/programmes, including on the external assistance platform (amp.gov.md) and other tools for monitoring external assistance projects.
Aplicarea facilităților fiscale și vamal: Applying tax and customs facilities to external assistance projects/programmes, in accordance with the international treaties to which the Republic of Moldova is a party and national eligibility criteria.
Asigurarea elaborării Raportului anual p: Ensuring the preparation of the Annual Report on External Assistance Received by the Republic of Moldova, in line with good practice and the provisions of the national framework, as well as other documents and questionnaires according to international standards in the field.
Coordonarea proiectelor investiționale f: Coordinating the investment projects financed under the Growth Plan, ensuring a coherent whole-of-government approach and effective communication between national authorities, international financial institutions and the European Commission.
Dezvoltarea și implementarea unui mecani: Developing and implementing a national mechanism for coordinating projects financed under the Growth Plan.
Asigurarea alinierii proiectelor investi: Ensuring that investment projects are aligned with national strategic priorities and with commitments made to external partners.
Coordonarea și accelerarea pregătirii pr: Coordinating and accelerating the preparation of investment projects in order to increase the absorption of Growth Plan resources.
Menținerea unui dialog continuu cu Comis: Maintaining a continuous dialogue with the European Commission, international financial institutions and other development partners to clarify the financing structure, conditionalities, implementation timetable and reporting requirements and to align projects with national priorities, as well as coordinating the national authorities involved (line ministries, beneficiary authorities, the Ministry of Finance and other institutions) in order to harmonise institutional approaches and consolidate national positions.
Organizarea și desfășurarea ședințelor d: Organising and holding trilateral and multilateral coordination meetings to assess the status of projects, clarify responsibilities and find solutions to any difficulties.
Monitorizarea progresului implementării: Monitoring progress in implementing projects, including compliance with deadlines, performance indicators and established conditionalities, identifying risks and bottlenecks in project implementation and proposing corrective measures.
Coordonarea dialogului tehnic și institu: Coordinating the technical and institutional dialogue with international financial institutions (IFIs) and the European Commission on issues of eligibility, financing, implementation and reporting.
Consolidarea capacităților instituțional: Strengthening the institutional capacity of the authorities responsible for implementing projects, including through methodological guidance and technical support.
Asigurarea transparenței și vizibilități: Ensuring the transparency and visibility of projects, including through periodic reports and public information.
Coordonarea procesului de raportare cătr: Coordinating the process of reporting to external partners on the status of implementation and the use of funds.
Elaborarea/promovarea și perfecționarea: Drafting/promoting and improving the national legal framework for the coordination and effective management of external assistance.
Coordonarea procesului de elaborare, pro: Coordinating the process of drafting, promoting and improving policy documents and legal acts in the field of attracting and implementing external assistance at national level.
Promovarea proiectelor acordurilor de as: Promoting draft external assistance agreements and related legal acts, in accordance with the procedures on international treaties and the external assistance coordination mechanism.
Coordonarea procesului de elaborare, pro: Coordinating the process of drafting, promoting, monitoring and amending international treaties and state contracts on development cooperation.
Coordonarea procesului de elaborare și p: Coordinating the process of drafting and promoting methodological documents on the implementation of State policy in the field of external assistance.
Acordarea suportului metodologic autorit: Providing methodological support to public authorities/beneficiaries in attracting, planning, implementing and making use of external assistance.
Coordonarea programării și negocierea cu: Coordinating programming and negotiations with the European Commission on the allocation of resources from EU pre-accession assistance for candidate countries/European funds, and developing the legal and methodological framework for managing European funds (Managing Authority, Intermediate Bodies, Certifying Authority, Audit).
Coordonarea procesului național de progr: Coordinating the national process of programming European funds, including drafting strategic and programming documents (operational programmes, partnership frameworks, etc.).
Asigurarea alinierii priorităților de fi: Ensuring that funding priorities are aligned with European Union policies and objectives and with national development strategies.
Organizarea și coordonarea procesului de: Organising and coordinating the inter-institutional consultation process and applying the partnership principle in the programming, management, monitoring and evaluation of projects financed from EU funds.
Conducerea procesului de negociere tehni: Leading the technical and institutional negotiations with the European Commission on financial allocations, intervention priorities and the related conditionalities.
Asigurarea coerenței și complementarităț: Ensuring coherence and complementarity between the various European financing instruments and other external sources.
Elaborarea, promovarea și actualizarea c: Drafting, promoting and updating the national legal framework for the management of European funds.
Dezvoltarea cadrului metodologic și proc: Developing the methodological and procedural framework for the operation of the management and control system for European funds.
Stabilirea rolurilor și responsabilități: Establishing the roles and responsibilities of the institutions involved: Managing Authorities, Intermediate Bodies, the Certifying Authority and the Audit Authority.
Coordonarea procesului de desemnare și a: Coordinating the process of designating and accrediting the institutional structures involved in managing the funds.
Asigurarea conformității sistemelor de m: Ensuring that management and control systems comply with European Union requirements and regulations.
Monitorizarea implementării programelor: Monitoring the implementation of programmes financed from European funds, including financial performance and result indicators.
Coordonarea proceselor de raportare cătr: Coordinating reporting to the European Commission and other relevant institutions.
Gestionarea relației cu autoritățile de: Managing relations with national and European audit authorities, including in the context of verification and control missions.
Identificarea și gestionarea riscurilor: Identifying and managing systemic risks in the implementation of European funds and proposing corrective measures.
Asigurarea transparenței și a comunicări: Ensuring transparency and public communication on funding opportunities and results achieved.
Sprijinirea pregătirii portofoliului de: Supporting the preparation of a portfolio of mature projects eligible for financing from European funds.
Asigurarea consolidării capacităților in: Ensuring the institutional capacity building of all actors involved in accessing and implementing European Union funds, including central and local public administration authorities, civil society organisations and other relevant beneficiaries, through training, coordination, methodological guidance and exchange of good practice.
Evaluarea periodică a necesarului de com: Periodically assessing skills needs and identifying capacity gaps in the institutions involved (Managing Authorities, Intermediate Bodies, Certifying Authority, Audit Authority).
Coordonarea unui program național de for: Coordinating a national programme of continuing training and professional development for civil servants involved in managing EU funds.
Organizarea de sesiuni de instruire, ate: Organising training sessions, workshops, exchanges of experience and mentoring programmes, including with the participation of external experts.
Asigurarea transferului de cunoștințe și: Ensuring the transfer of knowledge and good practice from EU Member States and from cooperation with the European Commission and other relevant institutions.
Dezvoltarea capacităților de utilizare a: Developing capacities for using the information systems specific to managing European funds.
Identificarea și mobilizarea resurselor: Identifying and mobilising financial resources for capacity-building activities (including from European funds and external assistance) in key areas: programme management, public procurement, monitoring and evaluation, financial control, audit and fraud prevention.
Integrarea dimensiunii de etică, integri: Integrating the dimension of ethics, integrity and prevention of conflicts of interest into training programmes.
Asigurarea coordonării implementării a 5: Ensuring coordination of the implementation of 5 territorial cooperation (Interreg) programmes financed by the European Union, in accordance with national legal acts, European Union regulations and the Financing Agreements concluded, and of programming under the Interreg strands for the period 2028–2034.
Exercitarea atribuțiilor și responsabili: Exercising the duties and responsibilities of National Managing Authority for the Interreg territorial cooperation programmes, in accordance with national legislation and European Union regulations.
Coordonarea și consolidarea sistemului d: Coordinating and strengthening the management and control system of the Interreg Programmes on the territory of the Republic of Moldova.
Asigurarea participării și luării decizi: Ensuring participation and decision-making in the Monitoring Committees and Programming/Planning Committees of the Interreg Strands/Programmes financed by the European Union.
Asigurarea suportului necesar structuril: Providing the necessary support to the programme structures for launching and running the call for project proposals on the territory of the Republic of Moldova, and at the stage of evaluating and selecting operations/projects.
Întreprinderea măsurilor necesare, confo: Taking the necessary measures, in accordance with the Financing Agreements and national legislation, to prevent and remedy any irregularity or possible fraud or corruption at any stage of the use of the funds allocated by the EU under the Programmes.
Conlucrarea cu beneficiarii/partenerii î: Working with beneficiaries/partners to remedy irregularities and providing the necessary assistance to the National Anticorruption and Antifraud Authority and the European Office in recovering EU funds obtained/used with irregularities, through fraud or corruption.
Asigurarea suportului necesar pentru Aut: Providing the necessary support to the Managing Authority in recovering EU funds allocated under the Programmes that were used contrary to their purpose or are not supported by documents.
Asigurarea încheierii și punerii în apli: Ensuring the conclusion and implementation of the Financing Agreements relating to the Interreg programmes/strands and related documents, including technical assistance contracts.
Asigurarea evidenței continue și vizibil: Ensuring continuous recording and visibility of the projects financed under the Interreg programmes.

Transparență pe domeniile de competență: Transparency in the areas of competence
Să solicite și să primească, în condiții: To request and receive, under the conditions of the legal framework, from the central public administration authorities, the subdivisions of the State Chancellery, local public administration authorities and other institutions/organisations the information needed to perform its duties, as well as sectoral reports/information notes on the situation in the areas of competence.
Să reprezinte, în limitele competenței f: To represent the State Chancellery, within the limits of its functional competence, and to cooperate with public administration authorities, public institutions, development partners and civil society organisations in the areas of competence, in order to exchange information and experience in the field and adopt good practices.
Să creeze grupuri de lucru interinstituț: To set up inter-institutional working groups to draft proposals for improving the national legal framework on the coordination and effective management of external assistance, including EU pre-accession assistance for candidate countries/EU funds.
Să participe la activități de instruire,: To take part in training activities, conferences, seminars and round tables on subjects within the Directorate's areas of competence, organised in the Republic of Moldova and abroad.
Să verifice executarea la termen de cătr: To check that ministries and other central public administration authorities comply on time with the legal framework and with the instructions of the Prime Minister and the management of the State Chancellery, according to competence.
Să antreneze autoritățile administrației: To involve public administration authorities, public institutions, development partners and civil society organisations in resolving any problems that arise in managing external assistance at national level in the areas of competence.
Să înainteze propuneri conducerii Cancel: To submit proposals to the management of the State Chancellery on forwarding the requests received by the Directorate to public authorities, according to competence.
Să prezinte propuneri și sugestii conduc: To submit proposals and suggestions to the management of the State Chancellery on improving its field of activity, and to give recommendations to and consult other subdivisions of the State Chancellery on matters within the Directorate's competence.
Să exercite alte drepturi în conformitat: To exercise other rights in accordance with the provisions of the legal framework in force and of the Regulation.
Să examineze și să avizeze proiectele de: To examine and endorse draft legal acts submitted by authorities in the areas of competence.
Să asigure coerența și complementaritate: To ensure coherence and complementarity between the instruments offered by the donor/creditor community and the development needs of the Republic of Moldova.
Să ofere suport coordonat pentru îndepli: To provide coordinated support for meeting the commitments made to the international community and, in particular, to the European Union.
Să asigure un management financiar durab: To ensure sustainable financial management of external assistance.
Să utilizeze sistemele și procedurile na: To use national systems and procedures in the process of coordinating and managing external assistance.
Să mențină un dialog transparent, coordo: To maintain a transparent, coordinated and comprehensive dialogue between the donor/creditor community, the national external assistance coordination authority and beneficiaries.
Să asigure realizarea funcțiilor și atri: To ensure that the functions and duties assigned in the areas of competence are carried out, in accordance with the legal framework and the Regulation.
Să identifice lacunele existente în cadr: To identify existing gaps in the legal framework in the areas of competence and to draft recommendations for eliminating them/improving the legal framework.
Să elaboreze Planurile anuale de acțiuni: To draft annual action plans for the areas of competence and to prepare periodic reports in accordance with the legislation in force.
Să asigure organizarea ședințelor temati: To ensure that thematic/sectoral meetings are held to resolve any problems that arise in managing external assistance at national level in the areas of competence.
Să asigure mobilizarea/funcționalitatea: To ensure the mobilisation/functioning of the sectoral councils in the field of external assistance.
Să elaboreze Registrul riscurilor, precu: To draw up the Risk Register and the core operational processes of the subdivision's activity.
Să execute, în modul stabilit, acțiunile: To carry out, in the established manner, the actions included in the activity plans and the current tasks of the management of the State Chancellery and of the Government.
Să exercite și alte funcții pentru îndep: To perform other functions for carrying out the tasks established in accordance with the legislation.
